# Duplex card printing registration and stock feeding — facts

> Source-anchored units about Duplex card printing registration and stock feeding: 21 across 6 sources. Each line ends in the URL and anchor it came from; `keywords:` names the lexicon terms that matched.

## How it works

- [statement] Paper preparation affects registration: Canon recommends factory mill-cut digital-compatible paper for consistency, while Xerox identifies paper expansion/contraction, inaccurate cutting and storage conditions as possible causes of misalignment or skew. (medium confidence) — https://downloads.canon.com/bicg2022/ced/svc-imagepress-v900-series-ced-rev2.pdf · keywords: Duplex card printing registration and stock feeding · also: https://download.support.xerox.com/pub/docs/XRIP_V180_EX/userdocs/any-os/en_GB/EN_SystemAdministrationGuide_Versant180Press_v1.0.pdf
- [statement] Canon warns that curl can cause diagonal feeding and that heavy paper may feed poorly even without curl. Its grain recommendations also depend on sheet size. (low confidence) — https://oip.manual.canon/USRMA-7565-zz-PS-900-enUS/contents/devu-beginning-dev_spec-papers.html · keywords: Duplex card printing registration and stock feeding
- [statement] Canon’s customer expectations document warns that customer-cut sheets can cause feeding and registration errors. It recommends clean cuts and factory mill-cut, digital-compatible paper for consistent front-back registration. (low confidence) — https://downloads.canon.com/bicg2022/ced/svc-imagepress-v900-series-ced-rev2.pdf · keywords: Duplex card printing registration and stock feeding

## Measurements and reference values

- [statement] The V900 Series US customer-expectations table limits engine drawers to uncoated 52–300 g/m2; its optional POD Deck Lite-C1 supports uncoated 52–350 and coated 85–350 g/m2. Feed-location limits therefore qualify the headline stock weight. (low confidence) — https://downloads.canon.com/bicg2022/ced/svc-imagepress-v900-series-ced-rev2.pdf · keywords: Duplex card printing registration and stock feeding
- [statement] Canon specifies separation rollers with air assist for the POD Deck Lite XL-A2, with a 350 g/m2 maximum for non-long sheets but 300 g/m2 for long sheets. (low confidence) — https://downloads.canon.com/bicg2022/ced/svc-imagepress-v900-series-ced-rev2.pdf · keywords: Duplex card printing registration and stock feeding
- [statement] Ricoh advertises 40–470 gsm media handling for the Pro C7500, and separately advertises built-in front-to-back registration and automatic duplexing up to 13 × 38 inches. This page does not establish that every stock at the maximum weight can duplex at the maximum size. (low confidence) — https://www.ricoh-usa.com/en/production-printing/products/pd/sheet-fed/pro-c7500-color-sheet-fed-printer · keywords: Duplex card printing registration and stock feeding

## Problems, failure modes and limitations

- [statement] Canon’s V900-series troubleshooting FAQ says misalignment below 1.0 mm may not be correctable. It explains that reversing the sheet makes the back print start from the opposite physical edge; this warning is not a measured repeatability distribution. (low confidence) — https://oip.manual.canon/FAQ01-0607-zz-PS_x2-enGB/contents/PS900-mcn_set_ajst-fix_misalignmentimg.html · keywords: Duplex card printing registration and stock feeding
- [statement] Ricoh advertises Pro C7500 automatic duplexing up to 13 × 38 inches, but its S14 banner-tray table limits sheets longer than 19.2 inches to 300 gsm. The 470 gsm headline cannot be combined with maximum banner length as an unrestricted capability. (low confidence) — https://assets.ricoh-usa.com/j2jqn9lauv41/4iS14kTGz7Yg4dXMTmtJVQ/e7f6b9516c8d5febbdb6eaa3f41a0940/Pro_C7500_Brochure.pdf · keywords: Duplex card printing registration and stock feeding
- [statement] Ricoh’s brochure contains conflicting tray ratings: its main table lists 40–470 gsm for Trays 3–8, whereas the RT5150 table limits Trays 5–8 to 40–400 gsm. These are attributed document positions; the installed configuration’s actual limit remains unresolved. (low confidence) — https://assets.ricoh-usa.com/j2jqn9lauv41/4iS14kTGz7Yg4dXMTmtJVQ/e7f6b9516c8d5febbdb6eaa3f41a0940/Pro_C7500_Brochure.pdf · keywords: Duplex card printing registration and stock feeding

## Comparisons and alternatives

- [statement] Air-assisted sheet separation is documented in both Xerox tray controls and Canon’s optional POD Deck Lite-C1. These are manufacturer feature descriptions, rather than independently measured feeding reliability. (medium confidence) — https://download.support.xerox.com/pub/docs/VERSANT_4100/userdocs/any-os/en_GB/Xerox_Versant4100Press_user_doc_en-us.pdf · keywords: Duplex card printing registration and stock feeding · also: https://downloads.canon.com/bicg2022/ced/svc-imagepress-v900-series-ced-rev2.pdf

## Facts and statements

- [statement] Canon advertises automatic duplex printing up to 350 gsm for the imagePRESS V900 Series; this is a manufacturer capability claim, not a measured card-production result. (low confidence) — https://sg.canon/en/business/imagepress-v900-series/main/product · keywords: Duplex card printing registration and stock feeding
- [statement] Canon says its optional Sensing Unit-B1 monitors and adjusts front-to-back registration before and during production, including adjustments during printing. (low confidence) — https://downloads.canon.com/bicg2022/ced/svc-imagepress-v900-series-ced-rev2.pdf · keywords: Duplex card printing registration and stock feeding
- [statement] Canon recommends at least 24 hours of paper acclimatization and thorough fanning before loading the V900 Series; it warns that paper from a different temperature/humidity environment may jam or print poorly. (low confidence) — https://downloads.canon.com/bicg2022/ced/svc-imagepress-v900-series-ced-rev2.pdf · keywords: Duplex card printing registration and stock feeding
- [statement] For the Versant 180, Xerox instructs operators to run automatic alignment before manual adjustment. Manual controls cover skew, scale, and lead/side image position, including misalignment between sides. (low confidence) — https://download.support.xerox.com/pub/docs/XRIP_V180_EX/userdocs/any-os/en_GB/EN_SystemAdministrationGuide_Versant180Press_v1.0.pdf · keywords: Duplex card printing registration and stock feeding
- [statement] The Versant 180 SIQA procedure creates alignment profiles for individual stock/tray combinations, with up to 50 profiles; Xerox says the profile is reused with its associated stock. (low confidence) — https://download.support.xerox.com/pub/docs/XRIP_V180_EX/userdocs/any-os/en_GB/EN_SystemAdministrationGuide_Versant180Press_v1.0.pdf · keywords: Duplex card printing registration and stock feeding
- [statement] Versant 180 air-assist volume is adjustable for custom paper types. Its Auto setting follows paper type/weight, while its Multifeed Support Table lowers air volume. These instructions are specific to this model. (low confidence) — https://download.support.xerox.com/pub/docs/XRIP_V180_EX/userdocs/any-os/en_GB/EN_SystemAdministrationGuide_Versant180Press_v1.0.pdf · keywords: Duplex card printing registration and stock feeding
- [statement] Xerox and Canon document separate corrections for skew, image distortion, scale and edge position. Front-to-back alignment therefore requires checking image geometry as well as translation. (medium confidence) — https://download.support.xerox.com/pub/docs/VERSANT_4100/userdocs/any-os/en_GB/Xerox_Versant4100Press_user_doc_en-us.pdf · keywords: Duplex card printing registration and stock feeding · also: https://oip.manual.canon/USRMA-7567-zz-PS-900-enUV/contents/devu-ptype_mng-img_posi-manual.html
- [statement] Xerox recommends paper from the same lot for duplex jobs. Its manual attributes front-back variation to sheet-size differences and fusing heat and pressure stretching the sheet. (low confidence) — https://download.support.xerox.com/pub/docs/VERSANT_4100/userdocs/any-os/en_GB/Xerox_Versant4100Press_user_doc_en-us.pdf · keywords: Duplex card printing registration and stock feeding
- [statement] For the Versant 4100, Xerox instructs operators to run automatic alignment first, then test individual manual changes. Its manual correction order is perpendicularity, skew, magnification, then registration. (low confidence) — https://download.support.xerox.com/pub/docs/VERSANT_4100/userdocs/any-os/en_GB/Xerox_Versant4100Press_user_doc_en-us.pdf · keywords: Duplex card printing registration and stock feeding
- [statement] The Versant 4100 manual distinguishes feed sources: the tray specifications immediately preceding Trays 6 and 7 allow 64–256 gsm, while Trays 6 and 7 allow 52–400 gsm. (low confidence) — https://download.support.xerox.com/pub/docs/VERSANT_4100/userdocs/any-os/en_GB/Xerox_Versant4100Press_user_doc_en-us.pdf · keywords: Duplex card printing registration and stock feeding
- [statement] Canon warns that paper stiffness, thickness, air permeability, smoothness and moisture absorption can prevent sufficient image quality or reliable feeding. A paper-weight rating alone does not establish compatibility with a particular card stock. (low confidence) — https://oip.manual.canon/USRMA-7565-zz-PS-900-enUS/contents/devu-beginning-dev_spec-papers.html · keywords: Duplex card printing registration and stock feeding
